Meet your lash artist

Hello, I'm Grace.

I'm a certified lash technician and I opened The Glam Studio in Little Common in autumn 2026, a calm space where you can switch off for an hour or two.

Every set is shaped around your eyes and the look you love, whether that's barely-there classics or full, fluffy volume.

  • Certified in eyelash extensions
  • One client at a time
  • Styled to suit your eye shape
  • Free patch tests for lifts
